asset.name: TokenUsageMeter
asset.description: The contextual capacity indicator showing used, estimated, and remaining context with semantic thresholds and explicit uncertainty on the estimated portion.

requires.reason: Bounded-capacity semantics are shared and are deliberately not task progress.
Certainty and urgency are expressed on the shared orthogonal axes rather than as one flat variant set.

rationale: Estimated usage must be visibly distinct from measured usage. Presenting a projection as a fact is the kind of quiet dishonesty that erodes trust in every other number on the surface.
